meaning: to be fond of, to like doing (hào, 4th tone)

senses.en: to be fond of, to like doing (hào, 4th tone)

note: Read hào before a verb: 好吃 (fond of eating), 好玩. Not hǎo "good".

examples.zh: 他小时候就好吃，现在很胖。
examples.en: He was fond of eating even as a child; now he's quite heavy.

examples.zh: 我爸年轻时好喝酒，现在不喝了。
examples.en: My dad liked drinking when he was young; now he doesn't.
She isn't keen on watching TV; she likes reading.

meaning: if (short for 要是), in a conditional clause

senses.en: if (short for 要是), in a conditional clause

note: Conditional 要 comes at the start of a clause, often with 就 in the next one.

examples.zh: 要下雨，我们就不去公园了。
examples.en: If it rains, we won't go to the park.

examples.zh: 你要有问题，就给我打电话。
examples.en: If you have a problem, call me.

examples.zh: 要没有你帮忙，我做不完。
examples.en: Without your help, I couldn't finish.

meaning: oh! (exclamation of surprise or sudden realization)

senses.en: oh! (exclamation of surprise or sudden realization)

note: Tone ā, said at the start of a sentence; not the sentence-final particle a.

examples.en: Oh, it's snowing!
Oh, it's you! Long time no see.
Oh no, I forgot my phone!

meaning: must, have to (děi, spoken)

senses.en: must, have to (děi, spoken)

note: Negative is 不用 or 不必, not 不得. Here it is děi, not the de of 跑得快.

examples.en: It's getting dark; I have to go home.
Tomorrow you have to arrive earlier than me.
How many times a day do I have to take this medicine?

meaning: verb complement: succeeding, hitting the mark (zháo)

senses.en: verb complement: succeeding, hitting the mark (zháo)

note: Verb + 着 (zháo): 睡着 fall asleep, 找着 find, 买着 manage to buy. Not the particle zhe.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上太热，我没睡着。
examples.en: It was too hot last night; I couldn't fall asleep.
Did you find your phone?
He fell asleep the moment he got into bed.

meaning: to part from, to leave (literary)

senses.en: to part from, to leave (literary)

note: Literary; shows up in 告别, 临别. For "don't", see the other 别.

examples.zh: 他别了老朋友，坐火车去了上海。
examples.en: He said goodbye to his old friend and took the train to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 他别了家乡，去北京工作。
examples.en: He left his hometown to work in Beijing.

examples.zh: 我们在机场别过，再没见面。
examples.en: We parted at the airport and never met again.

meaning: next in sequence; secondary, second-rate

senses.en: next in sequence; secondary, second-rate

note: Seen in 次日 (the next day), 次要 (secondary), 次品 (defective goods).

examples.zh: 次日早上，我们就出发了。
examples.en: The next morning we set off.

examples.zh: 这件事比较次要，先做别的。
examples.en: This matter is less important; do the other things first.
The event will be held the next month.

meaning: and/but; links two parts, often showing contrast or cause

senses.en: and/but; links two parts, often showing contrast or cause

note: 因为……而…… = because of …; 而 can also mean "whereas".

examples.zh: 我想去北京，而他想去上海。
examples.en: I want to go to Beijing, whereas he wants to go to Shanghai.

examples.zh: 他因为生病而没来上班。
examples.en: He didn't come to work because he was ill.
This restaurant is cheap and tasty.

meaning: ability, talent

senses.en: ability, talent

note: Mostly in 有才 (talented), 人才, 才华. Not the adverb 才 "only then".

examples.zh: 他很有才，写的歌大家都爱听。
examples.en: He's very talented; everyone loves the songs he writes.

examples.zh: 她是个有才的人，就是不爱说话。
examples.en: She's a gifted person; she just doesn't like to talk.

examples.zh: 公司想找有才的年轻人。
examples.en: The company wants to hire talented young people.

meaning: dozen (a set of twelve)

senses.en: dozen (a set of twelve)

note: Used as a measure word itself: 一打鸡蛋. Not dǎ "hit/play".

examples.en: I bought a dozen eggs.
This kind of pen comes twelve to a dozen.
Please give me two dozen beers.

meaning: sentence-final particle (na) softening a call or remark

senses.en: sentence-final particle (na) softening a call or remark

note: Takes the place of 啊 after a syllable ending in -n.

examples.zh: 天哪，我把钱包忘在家了！
examples.en: Oh my, I left my wallet at home!
Be careful, there's a car ahead.
Everyone, time to eat!

meaning: local, regional (as opposed to national)

senses.en: local, regional (as opposed to national)

note: Here dìfāng, with a clear fāng, and used before a noun: 地方政府. The "place" dìfang is another entry.

examples.en: This is a regional dish.

examples.zh: 地方政府会帮你办手续。
examples.en: The local government will help you with the paperwork.

examples.zh: 这里有很多地方特色的小吃。
examples.en: There are many local-style snacks here.

meaning: some, a few (a small, unspecified amount)

senses.en: some, a few (a small, unspecified amount)

note: Goes after 这/那/哪/一: 这些, 一些; also after adjectives: 快一些.

examples.en: I'd like to buy some fruit.
These books are all mine.
Please speak a bit more slowly.

meaning: to merge, to put together

senses.en: to merge, to put together

note: 并 as a verb: 合并, 并在一起. As an adverb ("not at all") it is another entry.

examples.zh: 这两家公司并成了一家。
examples.en: These two companies merged into one.

examples.zh: 把这两张桌子并在一起吧。
examples.en: Let's push these two tables together.
These two classes are to be combined.

meaning: to plant, to grow (crops, flowers)

senses.en: to plant, to grow (crops, flowers)

note: Verb, zhòng (4th tone). The measure word "kind" is zhǒng.

examples.zh: 爷爷在院子里种了很多花。
examples.en: Grandpa planted lots of flowers in the yard.
What can be grown here?
I'd like to plant a tree.

meaning: before, earlier than (a time or event)

senses.en: before, earlier than (a time or event)

note: Pattern: 事件/时间 + 之前. Opposite: 之后.

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating.

examples.zh: 来北京之前，你在哪儿工作？
examples.en: Where did you work before coming to Beijing?

examples.zh: 三年之前，我还不会说汉语。
examples.en: Three years ago I still couldn't speak Chinese.

meaning: but, yet (a result that goes against expectation)

senses.en: but, yet (a result that goes against expectation)

note: Goes after the subject and before the verb; often paired with 但是 or 可是.

examples.en: He's tired, yet he can't sleep.
The medicine is expensive, but it doesn't work well.
I wanted to help him, but he didn't want it.

meaning: to worry, to be anxious about

senses.en: to worry, to be anxious about

note: 担心 + person/thing: 担心你, 别担心.

examples.en: Don't worry, I'm fine.
Mom is very worried about your health.
What are you worried about?

meaning: dear, beloved

senses.en: dear, beloved

note: Used before 的: 亲爱的 + name/title. Warm, for letters, emails, close people.

examples.zh: 亲爱的各位朋友，欢迎你们！
examples.en: Dear friends, welcome!

examples.zh: 亲爱的，今天早点回家吧。
examples.en: Darling, come home early today.
Dear Teacher Zhang, hello!

meaning: darling, baby (a loving name for a child or partner)

senses.en: darling, baby (a loving name for a child or partner)

note: Also "treasure" as a thing, but today mostly a term of endearment.

examples.en: Sweetie, time to get up.

examples.zh: 我的宝贝，今天在学校开心吗？
examples.en: My darling, did you have fun at school today?

examples.zh: 他们家有个小宝贝，刚一岁。
examples.en: They have a little baby, just one year old.
